findings.title: [P2] Enforce signed 64-bit bounds on retained parent clocks
findings.body: The supervisor checks clock types and arithmetic relationships but never enforces the signed 64-bit range with the 10-second margin required by SCHEMAS.md and enforced by validate_object(). A narrow invented reproduction changed every slot's t0 and pick to 2**80 and adjusted the joint bounds consistently; validate_result() accepted it. Consequently, a malformed child result containing unsupported original clocks can pass the publication gate. Reapply the parent-clock range checks here before reconstructing picks and window bounds.

overall_explanation: The immutable hashes match, and the fixed component/joint denominators and geometry reconstruction are preserved. However, the supervisor accepts retained parent clocks outside the protocol's supported range, leaving an actionable result-validation gap. Verification used only public source and an in-memory invented fixture.
